stages.notes: Q materialization is explicit; K/V append is the following stage.
Writes only this invocation's K/V append; the persistent-state column records full current KV residency.
Explicit fusible Q read into the FlashAttention kernel.
KV traffic is linear in current context; split partials exist only when decode_splits > 1.
Reduces split-local output/LSE records to the final output.
Projects the attention result back to model width.
Router GEMM plus configured per-token/expert selection cost.
Materialized top-k dispatch; fusion remains visible as temporary traffic.
Up-projection GEMM and its weights for 28.4113 unique active experts.
Gate-projection GEMM carries its own expert-weight traffic.
SiLU and gate product; intermediate HBM traffic is zero only when expert intermediates are fused.
Down-projection GEMM carries its own expert-weight traffic.
Combines routed expert results and writes the block output.
Q materialization is explicit; K/V append is the following stage.
Writes only this invocation's K/V append; the persistent-state column records full current KV residency.
Explicit fusible Q read into the FlashAttention kernel.
Causal FlashAttention; score/probability matrices are never materialized in HBM.
Projects the attention result back to model width.
Router GEMM plus configured per-token/expert selection cost.
Materialized top-k dispatch; fusion remains visible as temporary traffic.
Up-projection GEMM and its weights for 128 unique active experts.
Gate-projection GEMM carries its own expert-weight traffic.
SiLU and gate product; intermediate HBM traffic is zero only when expert intermediates are fused.
Down-projection GEMM carries its own expert-weight traffic.
Combines routed expert results and writes the block output.
